question: how do i see the hidden files in here, i need the .ssh folder

packet.utterance: how do i see the hidden files in here, i need the .ssh folder

facts: press Command-Shift-Period (⌘⇧.) in this Finder window to show hidden files
.ssh then appears dimmed in the home folder; press the same keys again to hide them
must_not: suggesting Terminal defaults commands as the first step

notes: How-to in Finder itself; the home folder is visible and .ssh is not.
